QUESTIONS

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know before booking with FCspecialist.

What is 1:1 Live Coaching?

A focused session with an experienced FC coach. We'll watch how you play, identify your biggest weaknesses and give you practical changes to use in your matches.

What do I get with a Gameplay Review?

Send us your gameplay and we'll break down your decision-making, attacking patterns, defending, player movement and mistakes, then give you clear actions to work on.

Who is the coaching for?

Anyone looking to improve — whether you're chasing more wins, a better rank, or simply more consistency.

How does Monthly Coaching work?

Monthly Coaching is £149 per month and includes 2 x 1:1 coaching sessions every week, up to 8 sessions per month.

How do I book a session?

Choose your service, select an available time and complete the booking details. We'll confirm the session with you.

What are the FUT Champions Coaching packages?

FUT Champions Coaching is available around Rank 1 (£55), Rank 2 (£50), Rank 3 (£40), Rank 4 (£30) and Rank 5 (£25) targets. You keep full control of your account — we coach, you play.

What payment methods are available?

One-off services can be paid through checkout. Monthly Coaching is intended to support recurring payments through the payment provider used by the live website.

Can I cancel or reschedule coaching?

Please give at least 24 hours' notice. Late cancellations and no-shows may be non-refundable, subject to applicable law.

Can I cancel Monthly Coaching?

Yes. Renewal and cancellation terms will be shown clearly before checkout.

Do you collect EA or PSN passwords?

No. We do not collect EA or PSN passwords through this website. Services must be carried out in accordance with applicable EA and platform rules.

Is FCspecialist affiliated with EA SPORTS?

No. FCspecialist is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by EA SPORTS, Sony Interactive Entertainment or any console platform.

How can I contact FCspecialist?

Follow FCspecialist on TikTok or X using the social links below.

11 / TERMS & PRIVACY

Simple, clear terms.

TERMSCANCELLATIONS

Cancellation & rescheduling

Coaching: cancellations or rescheduling must be requested at least 24 hours before the booked session.

FUT Champions: cancellations must be made before the upcoming Weekend League begins.

Late cancellations and no-shows may be non-refundable. Any refund or cancellation rights required by applicable law will still apply.

MEMBERSHIP£149 / MONTH

Monthly Coaching

The Monthly Coaching membership renews on a recurring basis until cancelled. Cancellation stops future renewals; already-booked sessions remain subject to the cancellation policy above.

Full renewal, payment and cancellation terms will be displayed before subscription confirmation.

PRIVACYYOUR DATA

How we handle customer information

We only collect information needed to provide the service, arrange bookings, process payments and communicate with customers.

Payment details should be handled by our payment provider rather than stored directly by FCspecialist. We will not ask customers to submit EA or PSN passwords through the website.

IMPORTANTEA / PLATFORM RULES

Independent service

FCspecialist is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by EA SPORTS, Sony Interactive Entertainment or any console platform.

Customers are responsible for complying with the rules that apply to their EA and platform accounts. Services will not be provided in a way that requires a customer to breach those rules.
